Chapter 401 - 401 Hilltop Villa 1; Arrival!

Chapter 401 - 401 Hilltop Villa 1; Arrival!

401 Hilltop Villa 1; Arrival!

As soon as Zhou Guotao finished speaking, the entire hall quickly fell silent.

It was because the person who said this was the old man of the Zhou family, Zhou Guotao.

Since he said that he was looking for a divine doctor.

He must be an amazing doctor!

Perhaps the other party really could save the old master!

Thinking of this, everyone looked at Zhou Guotao with anticipation.

Zhou Guotao finally made a call.

After a while, the call connected, and Lin Fan’s clear voice came from the other end.

“Old Master Zhou, why did you call me today?”

Zhou Guotao did not waste any time and said, “Lin Fan, do you have time to come to Hong Kong to save someone?”

“Hong Kong?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

Zhou Guotao said, “I know this request is a bit difficult.

“But I have no choice.

“He’s a very good old friend of mine. Also, he played a part in the smooth return of Hong Kong.

“I really don’t want him to leave like this.”

Lin Fan said, “Old Master, you misunderstood. I’m coming over now. Where are you?”

Lin Fan was a person who would repay one’s kindness. Zhou Guotao had helped him several times.

Now that Zhou Guotao had a request, Lin Fan naturally would not reject it.

Moreover, the person he was going to save had contributed greatly to Hua Nation!

When Zhou Guotao heard this, his face could not help but reveal a hint of joy.

Lin Fan was willing to come over!

Old Tang was saved!

One had to know…

Zhou Guotao was saved by Lin Fan.

In fact, not only was he saved, but all his other ailments were also cured by Lin Fan.

In the past few months, he even felt that he had become a few years younger.

Otherwise, no matter how good Zhou Guotao’s relationship with Tang Mingyuan was, he would not have come all the way here just because Tang Mingyuan was seriously ill.

Zhou Guotao could say… he had personally experienced Lin Fan’s miraculous medical skills.

In addition, Zhou Guotao was one of the few people in Hua Nation who knew about Lin Fan’s other identities.

He was the captain of Dragon Division’s Team 10, he solved several math problems, he saved the life of Qin Weiming’s grandson, and he also invented the earthquake prediction device.

All of this proved that Lin Fan was extremely powerful.

That was why Zhou Guotao was so polite to Lin Fan.

Zhou Guotao quickly said, “I’ll get someone to book a plane ticket for you and pick you up at the airport.”

Lin Fan said, “No need. I’m in Hong Kong. Just tell me the location, and I’ll come over.”

Zhou Guotao was stunned for a moment.

Very soon, he was overjoyed. “We’re in Hilltop Villa 1!”

In fact, when Lin Fan agreed to come over, Zhou Guotao was still a little worried.

Of course, he did not doubt Lin Fan’s medical skills.

He was just worried that when Lin Fan arrived, Tang Mingyuan would already be dead.

After all, Jiangbei was still quite a distance away from Hong Kong.

Zhou Guotao did not expect Lin Fan to be in Hong Kong.

This was definitely good news, extremely good news!

After hanging up, Lin Fan said to Ling Rou, “A friend is seriously ill. I need to go over and take a look…”

“Then you should go quickly,” Ling Rou quickly said.”

She asked hesitantly after a pause, “Can I go with you?”

That was because Ling Rou knew that Lin Fan had other women.

What if this friend knew another woman?

Therefore, Ling Rou was a little cautious.

Lin Fan smiled. “Of course!”

Then, he called a driver under the Peninsula Hotel.

After a while, the Rolls-Royce Phantom stopped steadily in front of them.

Lin Fan put all the bags from the shopping spree into the trunk.

Then, he said to the driver, “Hilltop Villa 1.”

The driver was stunned.

Many ordinary people only treated the mountaintop villa as a scenic spot. They stood in the distance and took a few glances at it, sighing in admiration.

However, the driver knew that the people living in the villa area were all very important people.

Villa 1 was the residence of the Tang family, one of the two superpowers in Hong Kong.

Where was this customer going?

“Hilltop Villa 1?” the driver repeated.

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

After the driver received Lin Fan’s approval, he could not help but be more respectful to him.

The Rolls-Royce Phantom slowly started up. Like a boat sailing in water, it was very stable.

About half an hour later, they saw a villa located on the top of the mountain.

At this moment, two well-built security guards strode over and asked warily, “May I ask who you are? Why are you here?”

If it were a security guard from another place, they would definitely be very polite when they saw that the other party had come out of a Rolls-Royce Phantom. They would even try their best to please the other party.

However, Hilltop Villa, a Rolls Royce Phantom was nothing.

The security guards would be wary of the other party before confirming their identity.

Just as Lin Fan was about to reply, a large group of people walked over.

The leader was none other than Zhou Guotao, the old master of the Zhou family.

“Lin Fan, I didn’t expect you to come over so quickly. Old Tang is saved!” Zhou Guotao said happily.

When the Tang family members standing behind heard this, they were slightly stunned.

This was because they could easily tell from Zhou Guotao’s words that this young man was the divine doctor that Zhou Guotao was talking about.

Such a young divine doctor?

He was Zhou Guo’s recommendation. If it were someone else who recommended this young man, the Tang family would definitely shout at the other party for causing trouble.

Zhou Guotao did not pay much attention to them and said directly, “Lin Fan, time is of the essence. I won’t be polite. Let’s go in quickly.”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

Soon, everyone arrived at the hall.

Lin Fan said to Ling Rou, “I’ll go in and take a look at the patient first. You and Old Master Zhou wait outside for a while.”

“Alright.” Ling Rou nodded.

A tall and thin middle-aged man called Tang Kai saw Lin Fan walking into the ward and could not help but say, “Mr. Lin, we also have some doctors here. Do you need them to go in and help?”

As he spoke, he pointed at the three doctors beside him.

Even though Lin Fan was a divine doctor whom Zhou Guotao, the old man of the Zhou family, had called over, and he knew that Zhou Guotao would never harm his grandfather, Lin Fan was simply too young.

He was worried that if Lin Fan went in to treat the old man, it would put him in danger.

If the doctors followed them in, the danger would obviously be reduced.

How could Lin Fan not understand what he was thinking?

“There’s no need. I don’t like people following me around when I’m treating patients. I alone am enough.”

Tang Kai seemed to want to say something more, but he was stopped by the current head of the Tang family, Tang Hua, with a look.

Then, Tang Hua bowed slightly and said in a pleading tone, “Mr. Lin, I’ll leave the old master to you.”

His tone was very sincere. Lin Fan nodded slightly and said, “Don’t worry.”

After saying that, he strolled into the ward under the watchful eyes of everyone in the hall.
